title: D2C's Biggest Opportunity Has Nothing to Do With Platform Fees
description: The D2C conversation in games has been dominated by one number: saving 25-30% on legacy platform fees by monetizing directly to players. That argument misses the true opportunity now available to studios: lower risk, improved financial control, and unlocking new growth channels. Liam Wiltshire, VP and GM at Tebex, will show how the best-in-class D2C monetization adopters do differently using real data from Tebex's platform of 45,000+ gaming stores.
session_takeaway: Understand how to turn an existing player community into a wholly-owned revenue engine.
How to utilize direct-to-consumer pipelines to lower CAC and improve retention.
Real-world data benchmarks showing the impact of D2C on player LTV.
